title: Proteogenomic data and resources for pan-cancer analysis
authors: Li Y, Dou Y, Da Veiga Leprevost F, et al.
note: The harmonized pan-cancer data freeze of ten cohorts from which this database is built.

title: Connecting genomic alterations to cancer biology with proteomics: the NCI Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium
authors: Ellis MJ, Gillette M, Carr SA, et al.
note: Introduces the National Cancer Institute's Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium (CPTAC), which generated these protein-level cancer data.

title: The next horizon in precision oncology: Proteogenomics to inform cancer diagnosis and treatment
authors: Rodriguez H, Zenklusen JC, Staudt LM, et al.
note: Explains why measuring proteins together with genes (proteogenomics) matters for understanding cancer.

title: Proteogenomic Landscape of Breast Cancer Tumorigenesis and Targeted Therapy
authors: Krug K, Jaehnig EJ, Satpathy S, et al.
note: BRCA: breast cancer. The flagship study of this cohort.

title: Integrated Proteogenomic Characterization of Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma
authors: Clark DJ, Dhanasekaran SM, Petralia F, et al.
note: CCRCC: clear cell renal cell carcinoma, a kidney cancer. The flagship study of this cohort.

title: Proteogenomic Analysis of Human Colon Cancer Reveals New Therapeutic Opportunities
authors: Vasaikar S, Huang C, Wang X, et al.
note: COAD: colon adenocarcinoma, a colon cancer. The flagship study of this cohort.

title: Proteogenomic and metabolomic characterization of human glioblastoma
authors: Wang LB, Karpova A, Gritsenko MA, et al.
note: GBM: glioblastoma, a brain cancer. The flagship study of this cohort.

title: Proteogenomic insights into the biology and treatment of HPV-negative head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
authors: Huang C, Chen L, Savage SR, et al.
note: HNSCC: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HPV-negative). The flagship study of this cohort.

title: A proteogenomic portrait of lung squamous cell carcinoma
authors: Satpathy S, Krug K, Jean Beltran PM, et al.
note: LSCC: lung squamous cell carcinoma. The flagship study of this cohort.

title: Proteogenomic Characterization Reveals Therapeutic Vulnerabilities in Lung Adenocarcinoma
authors: Gillette MA, Satpathy S, Cao S, et al.
note: LUAD: lung adenocarcinoma. The flagship study of this cohort.

title: Proteogenomic Characterization of Ovarian HGSC Implicates Mitotic Kinases, Replication Stress in Observed Chromosomal Instability
authors: McDermott JE, Arshad OA, Petyuk VA, et al.
note: OV: ovarian high-grade serous carcinoma. The flagship study of this cohort.

title: Proteogenomic characterization of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
authors: Cao L, Huang C, Cui Zhou D, et al.
note: PDAC: pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. The flagship study of this cohort.

title: Proteogenomic Characterization of Endometrial Carcinoma
authors: Dou Y, Kawaler EA, Cui Zhou D, et al.
note: UCEC: uterine corpus endometrial carcinoma. The flagship study of this cohort.

title: Proteomic Data Commons: CPTAC Pan-Cancer
authors: National Cancer Institute Office of Cancer Clinical Proteomics Research
